name: The refresh token was spent outside the browser USER_MANAGER = ROTATION_SAFE
description: The test takes the refresh token the application keeps in the browser and spends it once itself, without touching the application at all. The renewal of the application is then a second use of the same token, and the provider refuses it. Expected with 'rotationSafe': the token is burnt instead of being presented again, and the renewal goes on through the hidden iframe, which asks with the SSO session cookie. The user sees nothing, and a fresh refresh token appears in the storage. (Where the browser keeps its cookie out of the iframe the popup comes instead.) Expected with 'original': nothing else is tried, and when the access token is over the popup "Session has expired" opens.
